Toolchains.Queued: Certification was scheduled. Build capacity remains unavailable until the real fixture checks pass. Refresh to see the result.

Storage.ComputeHint: The next Compute setup uses this drive for Linux builds and shared base disks. Newly enrolled providers also create their VM disks here. Existing providers keep their workload directories.

Storage.Docker: Docker manages the disk containing its images, build cache and volumes, including PostgreSQL and any model volumes. Run docker system df -v on the Docker host for a per-volume breakdown. Other WSL distributions have their own Linux filesystems.
